_doc: Agreed/proposed day plans — the WORKING PLAN, deliberately outside Notion. Nothing here is written back to the source databases until the whole review is agreed. Single source of truth for both the canvas proposed line and timetable.csv.

Beijing|1.title: all 9 kept · evening freed into the afternoon
Beijing|1.fix: AGREED (day 1). All 9 activities kept at their suggested times, venues unchanged, nothing removed. Qianmen is tagged Evening in Notion but needs no darkness (pedestrian shopping street) → moved into the afternoon. Shichahai does want dusk (bar lights, willow lakes, sunset ~19:20) → stays after dinner; because dinner keeps its Qianmen-cluster venue that costs a 26-min hop, so home is ~22:05 rather than ~21:40. OPEN OPTION for you: Jingshan Park (currently on d2) would fit the 15:20-17:00 gap and previews the Forbidden City you climb into on d2 — but that is a move off d2, so it is your call, not mine.

Beijing|2.title: same 8 stops, resequenced around closing times
Beijing|2.fix: PROPOSAL (day 2) — nothing added, nothing removed, same 8 stops. The retimed day already gets home 21:27, so time is not the problem; CLOSING TIMES are. Per the Hours field in Notion the National Museum runs to 17:30 in summer (last entry 16:30, closed Mondays — d2 is a Wednesday, fine), but as sequenced it is scheduled 15:28-17:58, so you lose the last 28 minutes and leave at closing. It also sits ON Tiananmen Square, so visiting it after Jingshan means walking north to the Forbidden City, further north to Jingshan, then back south again. Resequencing fixes both: square cluster together in the morning (Tiananmen + National Museum), Forbidden City after lunch, Jingshan last — it is directly outside the Forbidden City's north exit and open till ~21:00, so you get the rooftop panorama in late-afternoon light. Home time unchanged at 21:27. This is a REORDER, so it is your call.
